---
title: "Job watch"
format:
  dashboard:
    embed-resources: true
    nav-buttons: []
params:
  root: "job-watch"
  week: "2026-W01"
  script_dir: "."
  today: "2026-01-01"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# Reads only what the stage functions wrote. Nothing here fetches anything.
library(reactable)
source(file.path(params$script_dir, "jw_report.R")); jw_load(params$script_dir)
d <- jw_summary_data(params$week, params$root, as.Date(params$today))
link <- function(v) htmltools::tags$a(href = v, target = "_blank", "open")
tbl <- function(x, ...) if (is.null(x) || !nrow(x)) htmltools::p("none") else reactable(x, searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 25, ...)
```

# This week

## Row {height=18%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "New this week"
list(icon = "briefcase", color = "primary", value = nrow(d$new))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Closing within 14 days"
list(icon = "alarm", color = "warning", value = nrow(d$soon))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Near-misses"
list(icon = "exclamation-triangle", color = "info", value = if (is.null(d$near_miss)) 0 else nrow(d$near_miss))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr 'if (length(d$incomplete)) "INCOMPLETE" else "Complete"'
list(icon = if (length(d$incomplete)) "x-octagon" else "check-circle", color = if (length(d$incomplete)) "danger" else "success",
     value = if (length(d$incomplete)) length(d$incomplete) else "ok")
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "New opportunities (best class first)"
x <- d$new[, c("class", "status", "employer", "title", "country", "track", "deadline", "url")]
tbl(x, columns = list(url = colDef(cell = link, filterable = FALSE)))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Closing within 14 days"
tbl(d$soon[, c("class", "status", "employer", "title", "deadline", "url")],
    columns = list(url = colDef(cell = link, filterable = FALSE)))
```

# Near-misses

```{r}
#| title: "Items that fail exactly one hard rule"
tbl(d$near_miss[, c("employer", "title", "near_miss_rule", "why", "weakest_dimension", "evidence_url")])
```

# Sources

```{r}
#| title: "Sources (flag and status)"
tbl(d$sources[, c("section", "type", "status", "flag", "n_anchors", "n_job_like", "note", "url")])
```

# Discovery

```{r}
#| title: "Social and web leads"
tbl(d$s5[, c("platform", "query", "query_type", "lead_status", "text", "url", "note")])
```

# Run log

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Stages"
tbl(data.frame(stage = names(d$stage_status), status = unname(d$stage_status)))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Problems recorded this week (generic wording)"
tbl(d$problems[, c("stage", "severity", "code", "message", "n", "reported")])
```
